relations.subject: Ken McLeod

relations.subject: Ken McLeod
relations.evidence: In 1970, he met Ven. Kalu Rinpoche at his monastery outside Darjeeling, India, and began studying Tibetan Buddhism. Kalu Rinpoche became his principal teacher

relations.subject: Ken McLeod
relations.evidence: Other significant teachers included Dezhung Rinpoche, Thrangu Rinpoche, Gangteng Tulku Rinpoche, the sixteenth Karmapa, and Kilung Rinpoche.

relations.evidence: Also in that year, Kalu Rinpoche authorized McLeod to teach, and asked him to be the resident teacher at his Dharma center, Kagyu Dongak Chuling (KDC), in Los Angeles.

relations.subject: Ken McLeod
relations.evidence: In 1990, he left KDC to set up a non-profit organization, Unfettered Mind, as a vehicle for this approach.
